source:
@@U02976@@
This is the noblest mission of the young!
The world was not, until I gave it being.
I urged the sun to rise out of the sea.
It was I who set the moon on its changing course.
As I passed by the earth put on its finest,
grew green and blossomed to meet me.
At my sign, the stars in all their splendor
spread out in the heavens on that first night.
Who but I delivered you from the narrow,
literal-minded philistine?
But I’m free, free as the voice inside me,
and joyous to be so, to follow my inner light
and move as swiftly as thought can carry me,
day before me, and behind me night.

@@U02977@@
(Exit.)

@@U02979@@
Off you go in your glory, then!
What an original!
How it would wound him to know
that nothing wise or foolish can be thought
that wasn't thought many ages ago.
But there’s no harm in the boy.
Times change, things change;
a few years and all will be different.
However absurdly the grape juice foams and sputters,
in the end it turns into some sort of wine.

@@U02980@@
(To the younger members of the audience who fail to applaud.)

@@U02981@@
I see my words leave you cold, my dears,
but that’s quite all right; just remember,
the Devil’s old; when you're older,
you'll know what he’s about.
translation:
@@U02976@@
这是年轻人最崇高的使命！
世界并不存在，直到我创造了它。
我催促太阳从海里升起。
是我让月亮改变了轨迹。
当我经过大地时，大地披上了最美的色彩，
绿了，开了花来迎接我。
在我的星座，星星闪耀着它们的光芒
在第一个晚上就在天空中传播。
除了我，谁能把你从狭窄的困境中拯救出来，
字面意义上的市侩？
但我是自由的，就像我内心的声音一样自由，
并很高兴能够如此，追随我内心的光芒
并以思想所能带我的速度尽可能快地移动，
我面前是白天，我身后是黑夜。

@@U02977@@
（退出。）

@@U02979@@
那么，就带着你的荣耀出发吧！
多么原创啊！
如果他知道的话会对他造成多大的伤害
没有什么是明智或愚蠢的想法
许多年前人们并没有想到这一点。
但男孩并没有什么坏处。
时代变了，事情变了；
几年后，一切都会不同。
然而荒谬的是，葡萄汁会起泡沫并溅出，
最终它变成了某种酒。

@@U02980@@
（致未能鼓掌的年轻观众。）

@@U02981@@
我看到我的话让你感到寒冷，亲爱的，
但这没关系；只要记住，
魔鬼老了；当你年纪大了，
你就会知道他是怎么回事。
